title: Version 1.65.0
body:
Version 1.65.0 (💡 The Quick Thinkin' Update! 🧠)

August 18th, 2024

Added:

  • Introducing... the DONATOR! An ATM structure where the owner can define an amount they want donated, and users can donate to you! The structure will output their user id as a power. An interactor can change the donation amount.
  • The OWNERSHIP MANAGER! This can transfer ownership of your items to other players. Powering it with 10.0 clears the ownership, powering it with a user id transfers the ownership to that user.
  • The SPEAKER! This sends out a chat message to you (and your friends by default) when it is powered. Any text that says {num} will be replaced by the power input. If other people do not like these chat messages, they can disable them in settings. It has a global cooldown of one second.
  • Logic now also runs at a fixed clock speed. This may break some logic creations if it relied on inconsistent ticks. This had to be done in order to prevent exponential crashes, sorry!
  • 🤑 Donations and ⭐ Stars now display a notification in chat and on the top of your screen!
  • Donations will tell you who sent you the donation, and how much they sent.
  • Stars will tell you who starred your base!

Changes:

  • SO. SO. SO MANY IMPROVEMENTS. I have been working on this all week. I truly hope this works.
  • The interactor and collider have been changed, allowing you to select an entire REGION for it's interaction. This means you no longer have to spend hours trying to make your setup visually look nice, without an interactor hand STICKING out!
  • Another change to the interactor is that it will now interact with more than one object within its region.
  • Elevators should hopefully now be on the client. This means no more slow conveyors. Hopefully. I tried doing this last patch so I hope my changes mean it's actually working now.
  • Autosaves now happen every 5 minutes (previously 3 minutes).
  • The server performance of a bunch of machines has been improved. This should be noticeable if you have a BUNCH of them on your base. (except sanders)
  • A bunch of random things has been done to data saving to hopefully improve server performance.
  • Multithreading was broken for numerous systems. I spent forever adding this. AND. IT. DIDNT. EVEN. WORK. It now works :)
  • A few more improvements have been made for tree, rock, and scenery cleanup.

Fixes:

  • The build menu should now no longer randomly select a bunch of structures, yay!!
  • An incredibly rare bug where wires and trees on your base would vanish is now gone. I hated handling bug reports for this, took so much time.
  • The speed & fusion coil now REMEMBER if you were sprinting when you unequip them.

Version 1.65.1 (🚨 RAHHHHHHHHHH)

August 18th, 2024

Changes:

  • Store items now anchor when no player is in the store
  • The maximum amount of tumbleweed spawns has been lowered from 80 -> 10 due to performance
  • This is technical, but, the server sided loop handler has changed it's behavior in hopes that it improves performance
  • Tree, Rocks, and Scenery handler loops have been changed from intervals of 0.1 to 0.3

Fixed:

  • Fixed the donator not working for the first time (for setting the price)
  • Fixed a bunch of random errors

Version 1.65.2 (🚨 RAHHHHHH² 🚨)

August 19th, 2024

Changed:

  • Improved performance on the client (the client loop handler)

Fixes:

  • Fixed the wind lines & wind shake settings not working
  • Fixed a bunch more random errors

Version 1.65.3 (the erm, whar?? update (aka 🚨 RAHH🚨HHHH³ 🚨)

August 20th, 2024

Added:

  • wow. inspect. (Materials can now be inspected)

Changed:

  • physics are now at an adaptive timestep (60hz, 120hz, 240hz) instead of a fixed timstep (240hz). can't wait to see the performance graph on that! please ping me if this breaks stuff.

Fixed:

  • fps counte rWORKS!!!
  • you can no longer select structures THROUGH THE GROUND!!!
  • the basement entrance preview outline no longer GOES THROUGH THE FLOOR!!!!
